title: Clamp through a reference
prompt: Change the caller’s int into the closed interval [lower, upper]. If lower exceeds upper, throw std::invalid_argument without changing the caller. Inputs otherwise fit in int.

tests.label: Invalid bounds throw
tests.hint: The declared invalid range must be rejected.

hints: int& value is another name for the caller’s int.
lower and upper are copies; assigning to them cannot change value.
explanation: The reference has no ownership. Its caller keeps the int alive for the call. Validate first to give failure a no-change guarantee.
